KEYBIND_WAYPOINT: Set a waypoint to the last police alert
ADMIN_TAB_SETTINGS_DESC: Who gets alert cards and how long they stay.
ADMIN_C_ALERTS_DESC: Used while this is the alert script ai-core sends police alerts to (ai-core panel, Police alerts).
ADMIN_H_JOBS: On-duty members of these jobs get alerts that name no jobs of their own.
ADMIN_H_ALERT_SECONDS: How long an alert's blip and waypoint key stay, unless the alert names its own time.
ADMIN_H_CARD_SECONDS: How long the alert card stays on screen.
ADMIN_H_MAX_ALERTS: Most alerts an officer keeps on the map at once; a new one replaces the oldest.
ADMIN_H_SOUND: A sound plays when a card comes in.
ADMIN_H_BLIP: Map blip of an alert whose script sets no blip of its own. High priority alerts flash.
